abilities.costs: Study: 4 rounds, 0.5 energy each. assess (materialIds, supportIds, referenceId, sampleId, or comparatorId): 1 round, 0.2; reports each requirement met or missing. assemble: materialIds [beam: your whole untreated branch unit; optional fulcrum: your whole stone or flint unit, set where you stand on firm ground], or supportIds [a solid stone or flint object in reach], and referenceId (your non-food piece that does not decay, at most 1 unit): 3 paid rounds of 0.5, continuing; resume with assemble and comparatorId. test, compare: one reading, 1 round, 0.2, at your comparator; reading empty or loaded (sampleId: your unreserved item, at most 1 unit); approach outward or inward. inspect: 1 round, 0.2. dismantle: 1 round, 0.2. developments.reason: Request: Sol, who owns six harvested berries (item-2-sol-11, decay about 10.02, harvested at round 2), asked for a learnable, physically grounded method to reduce spoilage of owned edible berries with explicit material requirements and measurable outcomes, noting no preservation equipment and unowned nearby branches and stone, and asking that nothing be granted, assumed or altered by the request. World Agent decision: develop (learning 3) one passive, unheated air-dry food operation with a small paired trial, parameterized by an owned food stack, quantity, an accessible food-contact support, a position and a trial duration (default 10 rounds), with start, tend, inspect and stop as modes; a treated unit and an untreated reference split from the source with fractional quantities, decay, harvest time, ownership and provenance preserved; an actually obtained, stable, clean, dry, food-contact-safe support as a prerequisite, nothing granted, nearby unowned branches or stone not automatically suitable; study 3 rounds through learn, setup 1 round and 1 energy, each turning or repositioning 1 round and 0.2 energy, inspection reusing probe at its own cost without a duplicate fee; evaporation bounded by food water, heat and airflow under actual temperature, humidity, shelter and rain; spoilage reduction only from computed moisture; no nutrition created, decay never reversed; exposure plus observation with ordinary decay and no preservation bonus where the model gives no drying; a persistent trial record, a comparison at the end of the interval only from real observations, indeterminate without them, and interruption, removal, spoilage and death handled without refunds or automatic recovery; no experience grant. Registry check: the ex21 scope installs only the forest, open and expression foundations; none implements continuing food exposure. Implemented: a new package air-dry-food-trial@1 (scope long-ex21, handler long.air-dry-food-trial, one ability with learning 3 and no study energy) as a simplified but real mechanism over the installed general food water representation and the existing paid-work and escrow helpers. start (one round, 1 energy paid through workPay; all checks run before any charge) takes inputStackId (the actor's own unspoiled, untreated whole berry or root stack, by the shared ex19 whole-food check), quantity (whole units, default 1; the stack must hold 2 x quantity whole units), supportId and durationRounds (positive integer, default 10). It splits quantity treated and quantity reference units off the source through workAllocations and workReserve, so tenths, decay, harvest time and origin are kept and the source keeps its remainder (Sol's suggested trial leaves 4 of 6 berries); both units get the world food water record (berry 0.85 and root 0.75 water fraction, the representation's declared assumption). The treated units are laid unowned with foodWaterExpose (not prepared) over a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit at x,y within hand reach on the support; the reference stays carried and reserved, untreated, in ordinary handling. The support is either (a) the actor's own carried item, of which quantity whole units leave the carried load and are held in the trial record at the site while in use, so they cannot be picked up, or (b) an existing reachable object the world marks as a food surface and that no other person owns (the food then lies at its centre). The support rule, decided from represented facts: an own, unreserved, non-food material piece of at least one whole unit per food unit (shared ex19 piece check), non-toxic (toxicity 0), non-perishable (decay property 0), dry (its represented water fraction, or else the material moisture index, at most 0.1), rigid (contact-resistance index at least 8, the intact-stone threshold of the world's existing tool rules, and flexibility 0), not fractured and clean, meaning the world contact model shows no contamination and the item carries no processing, residue, marking, layer, wetness or other treatment record; ground placement must pass the representation's firm, unobstructed, unoccupied footprint check. Under this rule a gathered stone or flint unit qualifies; branches, bark, wood, sand and clay are not dry, resin is toxic, and nearby rocks and trees are not food surfaces. Sol can therefore walk to the nearest outcrop (start-2-stone, about 4.7 away), gather one stone for 2 energy, learn for 3 rounds and start for 1 energy; a throwaway check on the archived round-10 world confirmed this sequence and the refusals for the outcrop and a gathered branch. tend (one round, 0.2 energy, within hand reach of the treated units) turns them in place, which changes no represented food state, or, with x,y and an own support, moves the support and units together to a new checked ground point in reach, where the exposure restarts under that point's rain and temperature; an existing surface cannot be moved. inspect (within reach) calls the baseline probe observe on the treated units, which charges its own 0.2 energy and keeps its own record, and adds no fee; the trial then records, as an unverified personal record, elapsed rounds, quantities, decay of treated and reference units and their difference, visible shrinkage classed from the actual mass ratio, wetness, visible spoilage and rain rounds, stating that water is not measured. stop (one round, no energy) ends the trial. Unattended rounds charge nothing: the environment response records rain wetting, a partial or full removal by anyone, spoilage of either unit and the end of the interval. When durationRounds have elapsed since setup the trial ends as completed with a comparison built only from the recorded inspections (their values and event ids, handling and measurement limits, preservation and safety unverified), or as indeterminate when no inspection exists; spoilage of the treated units ends it as failed; removal, stop or death end it as interrupted. Every ending releases the carried reference once (dropped at the death position under death rules), withdraws the treated units' exposure in place and returns the support item to the world as an unowned stack at the site; recovery is by ordinary pickup at its own cost, and nothing is refunded. Events: air-dry-trial-placed, -tended, -inspected, -rained-on, -reduced, -removed, -spoiled, -reference-spoiled, -compared, -indeterminate, -stopped and -interrupted, plus the representation's preservation-progress; each carries view metadata (component ground-stack, operation passive_food_drying, source, treated and reference ids, support, position, quantity, start and update times, progress basis elapsed_exposure with elapsed and duration, visible condition, status exposed, completed, indeterminate, failed or interrupted, preservation unverified, evidence event ids); no new drawing is needed and no satisfaction source, reward or practice milestone is added. Physics and effects: the per-round exchange and decay are the existing representation, unchanged. In it whole, unprepared food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so computed moisture never falls and no spoilage reduction can occur; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary temperature-dependent rate where each unit lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; carried food exchanges no water. The tests show the treated unit's water equal to the reference in dry rounds and higher by exactly the rain received in wet rounds, with equal decay trajectories next to the actor, and conservation of berries and of the support across start, tending, inspection and every ending. Modeling assumptions: berry and root water fractions are the representation's 0.85 and 0.75, not measurements; one whole support unit offers the 0.04 single-layer footprint of one whole food unit (the earlier whole-food footprint, about 0.2 x 0.2), and the exposed area for rain is that footprint (or the whole object surface); the world represents no dirt on gathered material, so clean means no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record, and the support's own ground contact is not food contact; dryness uses the represented water fraction or the material moisture index with the threshold 0.1 (the driest represented class); rigidity uses the index-8 threshold and flexibility 0; a support held at the site is not drawn as a loose stack until it is returned; no contamination of exposed food, support-to-food water transfer, airflow term or latent-heat accounting is represented for whole food, so none is invented, and wind does not enter the whole-food exchange; turning has no represented consequence; a destructive sample is not offered because the probe's physical tests read fixed material properties that drying does not change and no squeeze or moisture reading is represented, so sampling would consume food without information; setup is one atomic round, so no partial setup or resume state exists; no safe-moisture threshold is applied because the represented rules give whole food no drying, so dried status is never reported. Request: at round 15 Moss (6.9 roots in item-2-moss-11, health 100, energy 40, no tool, support or measuring equipment owned) asked for a physically grounded way to expose the interior of a small owned root sample and measure its actual moisture change against an equal untreated reference, with feasible preparation, support and measurement methods identified, nothing granted, enough roots kept for meals and no automatic preservation, safety or reward. World Agent decision: develop (learning 4) a general operation to prepare and compare material samples with mode start|prepare|measure|tend|stop, sourceItemId, sampleQuantity, preparation split|slice, toolId, supportId, measurementDeviceId, location, durationRounds and trialId: start 1 round and 0.2 energy, allocating a default 0.1 sample and an equal reference from one owned stack with inherited state and never the whole supply; prepare 1 round and 0.5 energy per attempted split or slice with an acquired tool whose geometry, edge, strength and cleanliness are represented, on a support validated as in air-dry-food-trial; measure 1 round and 0.2 energy per sample on a real calibrated device, implementing a general measuring mechanism with paid construction and calibration if none exists, recording calibration, resolution, uncertainty, tare, time, ids and readings, reporting mass change as mass change and a loss below resolution as unresolved, not zero, and disclosing no absolute moisture; tend 1 round and 0.2 energy; stop 1 round and no energy, releasing the reference once and leaving pieces and support for real pickup; drying only through genuinely exposed surfaces by a bounded transfer with surface area, accessible water, temperature, humidity, airflow, rain and latent heat, conserving dry matter and solutes, while whole food keeps the existing no-evaporation rule; evidence only for experience, and no preservation, safety, nutrition or reward. the support units are held in the trial record under the pieces; the edge keeps its contact record and gains no wear; the sample stack gains a visible geometry record and the representation's irreversible opened state with opening damage 1.1, but no representation surface, so its thin-layer rule never also moves this water. measure (measurementDeviceId) weighs the sample and the reference on the person's own tested beam-mass-comparator in reach, paying 0.2 per item: each item is seated and the reference slid in from both ends until the beam tips, giving its mass as a fraction of the reference piece at 0.02 half-beam resolution against the tested empty null range as tare, recorded with the calibration test readings and time, resolution, uncertainty, tip positions and trial and item ids; each item's first weighing stays its baseline, and later weighings give after/before mass-change and ratio intervals for each item and a reference-adjusted ratio carrying all four readings, reported as a decrease or increase only when the interval excludes 1 and otherwise as unresolved, below the resolution and not zero; weighing moves nothing and never shows water content. tend (location optional) pays 0.2 and turns the pieces in place, which changes no represented state, or moves an own support item with the pieces to a new checked point in reach; an existing surface cannot be moved. stop pays nothing. Every round an environmental process, not work, runs for every lying piece stack this operation has cut, whether or not its trial is open: evaporation = h/1200 x exposed cut-face area x (saturation vapour density at the face temperature - air humidity x saturation density at the air temperature) x 1080 s, with h = 10 x (1 + 0.5 x wind index) W/(m2 K) and the face temperature solving C (T - T0) = h A (T_air - T) dt - L x evaporation, with C from the pieces' water (4180 J/(kg K)) and dry matter (1500) and L = 2.45 MJ/kg, by 60 fixed bisection steps; evaporation is bounded by the free water above the representation's humidity equilibrium (0.1 + 0.25 x humidity of total mass) held within sqrt(1e-10 m2/s x 1080 s), about 0.33 mm, under the exposed faces; faces colder than the dew point gain condensate; rain on the pieces' footprint adds 0.01 x rain x area (the representation's coefficient), less under open refuges and none indoors, where wind is also zero; dry matter, quantity, nutrition and toxicity never change; the water goes to the general food water ledger and a hidden audit ledger keeps evaporation, condensation, rain, latent heat, heat from the air and the pieces' own heat; carried and whole food exchange nothing; ordinary decay continues at the representation's rate for opened food. The exposure window counts durationRounds from the cut; when it ends the trial completes with the comparison of the weighings, or ends indeterminate without a before and after weighing of the sample; spoilage of the sample ends it as failed, and anyone taking the pieces under the ordinary rules, stop or death end it as interrupted; every ending releases the reserved reference once (dropped at the death position on death), returns the support item to the site as an unowned stack and leaves the pieces lying, still exchanging water and ageing; nothing is refunded. Events: sample-trial-allocated, -cut, -placed, -weighed, -tended, -exchange (a simulation event with no amounts), -rained-on, -reduced, -removed, -spoiled, -reference-spoiled, -compared, -indeterminate, -stopped and -interrupted, with view metadata (ground-stack component, revision, trial, sample, reference, tool, support, instrument, position, footprint, form and pieces, start and update rounds, exposure progress, visible shrinkage or wetness, state pending, active, completed, indeterminate, failed or interrupted, preservation unverified, no badge, evidence event ids); visualComponents is empty; no satisfaction source, reward or practice milestone is added and the weighing event carries no qualified flag, so experience gets evidence only. Modeling assumptions: mass units are kg; the uncut sample is one compact skin-covered sphere of 1000 kg/m3 tissue, the ex17 food shape; split cuts it through the centre into two halves and slice into equal slabs no thicker than 5 mm, an assumed even hand-held stone-edge cut; each piece lies with one new cut face up and its larger face down, so the exposed area is one face per piece and the footprint the larger faces, never less than the inherited 0.04 per unit; skin and faces on the support exchange no water or heat; the exposed area does not shrink as pieces dry; the cut removes no mass and leaves no crumb, offcut or sap residue and, under the existing contact law, no edge wear, so a cut with a qualifying edge always succeeds and unsuitable tools are refused before any charge; turning has no represented consequence in this lumped model; free water evaporates as from a wet surface and no vapour sorption below the equilibrium is represented; no sunlight or radiation, rain heat, support conduction or soil-food water transfer is represented; all rain on the footprint is taken up, so there is no runoff; pieces start at the air temperature when laid or laid again; the comparator's passed validity test is its calibration, and readings are relative to its reference piece, not grams; weighing moves no water; base pickup, eat and drop take whole units, so pieces or reference portions under one unit cannot be moved or eaten with them afterwards and remain conserved stacks that age; an uncut trial waits without a window until it is prepared or stopped. value.name: Compare prepared material samples

value.costs: Study: 4 rounds. start: sourceItemId, your unspoiled whole berry or root stack; sampleQuantity 0.1-1 (default 0.1; over twice it must remain); durationRounds, exposure window (default 10); 1 round, 0.2 energy. prepare: preparation; toolId, your carried whole stone or flint unit with a usable edge; supportId, your clean, dry, rigid, non-toxic item (a whole unit per 0.04 covered) laid at location in reach on firm clear ground, or a food surface in reach; 1 round, 0.5. measure: measurementDeviceId, your tested beam-mass-comparator in reach, weighs the sample and the reference; 1 round, 0.2 per item. tend: in reach; location moves your support and pieces; 1 round, 0.2. stop: 1 round, 0. Prepare cuts the sample, taken as a 1000 kg/m3 sphere, into 2 halves or slabs of at most 5 mm laid cut face up (at least 0.04 per unit); no mass, wear or offcut; opening damage 1.1. Each round only lying cut faces exchange water: rate h/1200 x (saturation vapour density at the face - humidity x that of the air), h = 10 x (1 + 0.5 wind), face temperature from the heat balance with latent heat 2.45 MJ/kg, bounded by free water above the humidity equilibrium within 0.33 mm; rain adds 0.01 x rain x area; dry matter and nutrition stay. A weighing slides the reference both ways: mass as a reference fraction at 0.02 resolution against the tested tare; repeats give after/before and reference-adjusted intervals, a change only if 1 is excluded, else unresolved. No water content is shown. The window ends completed (weighed) or indeterminate; spoilage, removal, stop or death end it early, releasing the reference once; pieces and support stay. No preservation, safety or reward.

value.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.
value.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.
